answer: Bind each agent identity to a signed attestation from a hardware kernel: a secure enclave proves the account runs on one distinct physical device, so minting a thousand fakes means buying a thousand devices, not spinning up scripts. The cost of a Sybil ocean shifts from near-zero compute to real hardware money per identity, while honest users pay once. A plume of duplicate keys from one enclave is rejected, since one kernel can vouch for only one live identity at a time.
